bio.1: He has long been the local member, is a minister, and played basketball for India.
bio.3: MLA for Surrey-Fleetwood since 2017 (also 2009-2013; Surrey-Panorama Ridge 2004-2009). Minister of Mining and Critical Minerals since November 2024. Former India national basketball player, public administration master's, ex-director of SEEDS. Lives in Surrey with family.
bio.5: Born in India; former India national basketball player; MPA; SEEDS executive director; MLA Surrey-Panorama Ridge (2004 by-election), Surrey-Fleetwood 2009-2013 (lost in 2013) and 2017 on; Minister of State for Trade, then Mining and Critical Minerals minister (November 2024 on).

record_note.3: Voted with his party on every recorded vote checked. As minister, approved the Eskay Creek mine under DRIPA's first consent agreement. Local pledges: hospital, SkyTrain, jobs, housing; no timelines.
record_note.5: Yea on Bills 36, 44, 46, 7, 14, 15, 32, 24, 3; nay at first reading on property rights, gender identity and Human Rights Code repeal bills. Voted with his party on every recorded vote checked. Approved Eskay Creek under DRIPA. No Gitxaala or extortion statement found.

record_note.3: No voting record or published local positions beyond party themes. Scored on the Conservative platform.
record_note.5: No electoral history; no published statements on SkyTrain, extortion, the Surrey Police Service or the hospital; no 2026 controversy or endorsement found. Scored as Conservative.

bio.5: 25-plus years senior leadership at a BC engineering and equipment supply firm (pollution control, energy optimization); Fleetwood resident since 2000; priorities 'affordability, housing, tax fairness and environmental sustainability'; results: 2013 1,147 (5.8%), 2017 2,004 (9.7%), 2024 1,321 (6.5%).

record_note.3: No voting record. Stated priorities match the Green platform; no local statements on SkyTrain, extortion or the hospital found. Scored on the Green platform.
record_note.5: No divergence from party found; no 2026 controversy or endorsement found. Scored as Green.
